description: Every past unusual time on one coin inside your window, oldest first, with the price then, a day later and the move either way; then the counts both ways and the one record sentence. Free: the last 24 hours plus the record dots.

coin.description: Coin symbol, e.g. BTC. A pair like ETH/USD works too.

cursor.description: Next page: the cursor from the previous answer.

detail.description: brief (default): the answer, key numbers and top rows. full: every row, paged with cursor.

kind.description: whales, forced (a wave of forced closes), fee (a costly fee) or all (default).

limit.description: Rows to return (usually up to 10; more is clamped and said).

question.description: The question to answer, as it was asked (e.g. "why is ETH down today"). `answer` is then written for it.

name: what_followed

access_note.description: What this connection could not return.

available.description: False: no data; note says why.

truncated.description: Lists shortened to their top rows; trimmed has shown of all per list and note says it in words.

title: What followed the last times
